name: Vercel Geist
description: Vercel-inspired dark theme — pure black, 10-step gray scale, restrained color, Geist Sans/Mono fonts, 4px grid, minimal radius

cssDesignGuidelines.backgrounds: Pure black (#000) for page, #111 for cards/panels, #1a1a1a for elevated surfaces, #252525 for hover states
cssDesignGuidelines.text: #ededed for primary, #a1a1a1 for secondary, #666 for muted/placeholder, #333 for disabled
cssDesignGuidelines.borders: 1px solid #252525 default, #333 on hover. Never use colored borders except for status indicators
cssDesignGuidelines.color_usage: Color is for MEANING only — success (#0070F3 blue), warning (#f5a623 amber), error (#e5484d red), info (#666 gray). Never use color for decoration
cssDesignGuidelines.radius: 2px for small elements (badges, chips), 4px for cards/inputs, 6px for modals/dialogs. Never use rounded-full or large radius on containers
cssDesignGuidelines.typography: Geist Sans for UI, Geist Mono for code/IDs/timestamps. Font sizes: 13px body, 12px secondary, 11px muted, 16-20px headings
cssDesignGuidelines.buttons: Ghost/outline by default (transparent bg, #252525 border, #ededed text). Filled only for primary CTA (#ededed bg, #000 text). Blue (#0070F3) only for links
cssDesignGuidelines.inputs: #111 bg, #252525 border, #ededed text, #666 placeholder. Focus: #333 border (no glow, no ring)
cssDesignGuidelines.cards: #111 bg, #252525 border, no shadow. Hover: #1a1a1a bg or #333 border
cssDesignGuidelines.status_dots: 6px circles — blue for success/active, amber for in-progress/warning, red for error, gray for queued/inactive
cssDesignGuidelines.animations: Minimal — 150ms ease-out for hover transitions, opacity fade for new content. No bouncing, no sliding, no glow effects
cssDesignGuidelines.dark_mode_note: This IS the dark mode. No light mode toggle needed. Pure black, not dark gray
